missingCanonical.title: Langfuse
missingCanonical.description: Traces, evals, prompt management and metrics to debug and improve your LLM application. Integrates with Langchain, OpenAI, LlamaIndex, LiteLLM, and more.

missingCanonical.title: About Langfuse - Langfuse
missingCanonical.description: Learn more about Langfuse's story and our team.

missingCanonical.title: Blog - Langfuse
missingCanonical.description: The latest updates and releases from the Langfuse team.

missingCanonical.title: Introducing Langfuse 2.0: the LLM Engineering Platform - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: Extending Langfuse’s core tracing with evaluations, prompt management, LLM playground and datasets.

missingCanonical.title: Trace complex LLM applications with the Langfuse decorator (Python) - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: When building RAG or agents, lots of LLM calls and non-LLM inputs feeds into the final output. The Langfuse decorator allows you to trace and evaluate holistically.

missingCanonical.title: Haystack <> Langfuse Integration - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: Easily monitor and trace your Haystack pipelines with this new Langfuse integration.

missingCanonical.title: Monitoring LLM Security & Reducing LLM Risks - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: LLM security requires effective run-time checks and ex-post monitoring and evaluation. Learn how to use Langfuse together with popular security libraries to protect prevent common security risks.

missingCanonical.title: AI Agent Observability, Tracing & Evaluation with Langfuse - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: Trace, monitor, evaluate, and test AI agents in production. Learn about agent observability strategies, evaluation techniques, and how to use Langfuse with LangGraph, OpenAI Agents, Pydantic AI, CrewAI, and more.

missingCanonical.title: Dify x Langfuse: Built in observability & analytics - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: The popular LLM development framework Dify.AI now integrates with Langfuse out of the box and in one click.

missingCanonical.title: What is LangChain? - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: The article answers the question - 'What is LangChain?' and provides insight into the advantages and disadvantages of using LangChain to build LLM applications. It also touches on LangServe, LangGraph, and LangSmith.

missingCanonical.title: Should you use an LLM Proxy to Build your Application? - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: We go over the advantages and disadvantages of using an LLM proxy.

missingCanonical.title: Observability in Multi-Step LLM Systems - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: Optimize multi-step LLM systems with advanced observability, feedback, and testing strategies for better performance and reliability.

missingCanonical.title: OpenTelemetry (OTel) for LLM Observability - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: Explore the challenges of LLM observability and the current state of using OpenTelemetry (OTel) for standardized instrumentation.

missingCanonical.title: Langfuse Launch Week #2 - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: A new feature launch every day. Dedicated to unlocking model capabilities and integrating Langfuse tightly in your development loop.

missingCanonical.title: LLM Product Development for Product Managers - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: Learnings from working with hundreds of teams on how to build great AI products.

missingCanonical.title: Langfuse is the #1 most used Open Source LLMOps Product - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: Langfuse is the leading Open Source LLMOps product, trusted by thousands of teams for its robust tracing and evaluation, seamless integrations, and extensive community.

missingCanonical.title: From Zero to Scale: Langfuse's Infrastructure Evolution - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: A deep dive into how Langfuse's infrastructure evolved from a simple prototype to a scalable observability platform.

missingCanonical.title: Evaluating and Monitoring Voice AI Agents - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: Learn how to use Langfuse in your Voice AI development workflow for comprehensive voice agent testing and optimization.

missingCanonical.title: The Agent Deep Dive: David Zhang’s Open Deep Research - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: Exploring Zhang’s open-source Deep Research. We look at the prompting, search executions, and report creation, and compare it to both OpenAI’s and Perplexity’s Deep Research solutions.

missingCanonical.title: Langfuse February Update - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: We've had a busy February at Langfuse, filled with new integrations, features, and announcements.

missingCanonical.title: LLM Evaluation 101: Best Practices, Challenges & Proven Techniques - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: Explore proven strategies for LLM evaluation — from offline and online benchmarking – this post briefs you on the state of the art.

missingCanonical.title: 🤗 Hugging Face and 🪢 Langfuse: 5 Ways to use them Together - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: Hugging Face and Langfuse are popular platforms to develop and run LLM applications. This guide shows you 5 ways how to use both platforms together to simplify open source LLM development.

missingCanonical.title: Comparing Open-Source AI Agent Frameworks - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: Get an overview of the leading open-source AI agent frameworks—LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, Smolagents, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, Strands Agents, Pydantic AI, Agno, Mastra, and Microsoft Agent Framework. Compare features, learn when to use each, and see how to track agent behavior with Langfuse

missingCanonical.title: Langfuse March Update - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: Langfuse March Update: New UI, Prompt Composability, Environments & More!

missingCanonical.title: How we use LLMs to build and scale Langfuse - Langfuse Blog
missingCanonical.description: Building a fast-growing open-source project with a small team is fun. These are some of the ways how we use LLMs to accelerate.

canonicalMismatch.title: Analytics Alpha - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: For early-users on Langfuse Cloud, we are releasing an alpha version of our analytics dashboards.

canonicalMismatch.title: Tokenization for exact token counts - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: For OpenAI and Anthropic models token counts are now automatically calculated. This is helpful for streaming endpoints that do not return usage data.

canonicalMismatch.title: Add manual scores - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: Do 'human-in-the-loop' evaluation by adding manual scores right in the Langfuse UI.

canonicalMismatch.title: Track version and releases - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: Compare metrics across releases of your application or version of your chain/prompt. Releases are automatically tracked for major hosting providers.

canonicalMismatch.title: Usage in USD - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: In addition to token counts, usage can now be displayed in USD. Available for many popular models.

canonicalMismatch.title: Public access to analytics alpha - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: All users on cloud.langfuse.com have access to analytics dashboards. More analytics to come soon in core Langfuse project.

canonicalMismatch.title: Model-based evaluation - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: Run model-based evaluations on your production data in Langfuse using the Python SDK.

canonicalMismatch.title: Export generations (for fine-tuning) - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: Filter generations and export them as CSV, JSON, or OpenAI-JSONL

canonicalMismatch.title: Datasets (beta) - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: Collect sets of inputs and expected outputs in Langfuse to evaluate your LLM app. Use evaluations to benchmark different experiments.

canonicalMismatch.title: Dashboards out of alpha - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: New core dashboard with analytics on token usage, latencies, and scores/metrics.

canonicalMismatch.title: OpenAI SDK Integration - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: Drop-in replacement for OpenAI's Python SDK to get full visibility by changing only one line of code.

canonicalMismatch.title: Simplified Docker deployment - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: You can now upgrade to the latest version of Langfuse by pulling the latest container. Database migrations are applied automatically on startup. Optionally, one-click deploy via Railway.

canonicalMismatch.title: SSO enforcement - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: Optional SSO enforcement on an organizational level for advanced security.

canonicalMismatch.title: OpenAI SDK integration now supports v1.x and v0.x - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: OpenAI has released a major SDK update. The latest Langfuse integration now supports both the new and old versions, ensuring optimal backwards compatibility with other packages.

canonicalMismatch.title: Sessions - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: Group multiple traces into a session and replay interactions between users and your LLM based application.

canonicalMismatch.title: SDKs v2.0.0 - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: We are excited to announce the release of v2.0.0 for Python and JS/TS SDKs. Langfuse has come a long way this year since initially launching v1 of the SDKs and it was time to finally group some necessary breaking changes into one release. The release includes simpler interfaces in Python, better defaults for the Langchain integration, and a performance upgrade for the JS/TS SDK. Read on for more details.

canonicalMismatch.title: Prompt Management - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: Manage, version and deploy prompts from within Langfuse.

canonicalMismatch.title: Trace Tagging - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: Categorize and manage your traces with tags in Langfuse.

canonicalMismatch.title: Custom model prices (Langfuse v2.0) - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: The new major version allows you to track usage and costs for many more models and for the first time also allows you to add custom models and prices.

canonicalMismatch.title: SDK-level prompt caching - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: The latest release of the Python and JS/TS Langfuse SDK includes a new prompt caching feature that improves the reliability and performance of your applications.

canonicalMismatch.title: New API: GET /metrics/daily - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: Retrieve aggregated daily usage metrics via a unified endpoint. Filters for application type, user, or tags are available for tailored data retrieval.

canonicalMismatch.title: Store additional structured data in Langfuse Prompt Management - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: Version control model names, model parameters, and additional json data in Langfuse Prompt Management.

canonicalMismatch.title: Token/cost tracking for Claude 3 models - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: Langfuse automatically tracks token counts and USD spend for Anthropic Claude 3 models

canonicalMismatch.title: Decorator-based tracing for Python - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: Use @observe() decorator to trace Python functions, fully compatible with the native integrations with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and the OpenAI SDK.

canonicalMismatch.title: OpenAI Integration tracks used Langfuse Prompts - Langfuse
canonicalMismatch.description: The OpenAI SDK integration for Langfuse Tracing now supports capturing the used prompt (version) from Prompt Management.

routes.title: Dashboards out of alpha - Langfuse
routes.description: New core dashboard with analytics on token usage, latencies, and scores/metrics.

routes.title: OpenAI SDK Integration - Langfuse
routes.description: Drop-in replacement for OpenAI's Python SDK to get full visibility by changing only one line of code.

routes.title: Simplified Docker deployment - Langfuse
routes.description: You can now upgrade to the latest version of Langfuse by pulling the latest container. Database migrations are applied automatically on startup. Optionally, one-click deploy via Railway.

routes.title: SSO enforcement - Langfuse
routes.description: Optional SSO enforcement on an organizational level for advanced security.

routes.title: OpenAI SDK integration now supports v1.x and v0.x - Langfuse
routes.description: OpenAI has released a major SDK update. The latest Langfuse integration now supports both the new and old versions, ensuring optimal backwards compatibility with other packages.

routes.title: Sessions - Langfuse
routes.description: Group multiple traces into a session and replay interactions between users and your LLM based application.

routes.title: SDKs v2.0.0 - Langfuse
routes.description: We are excited to announce the release of v2.0.0 for Python and JS/TS SDKs. Langfuse has come a long way this year since initially launching v1 of the SDKs and it was time to finally group some necessary breaking changes into one release. The release includes simpler interfaces in Python, better defaults for the Langchain integration, and a performance upgrade for the JS/TS SDK. Read on for more details.

routes.title: Prompt Management - Langfuse
routes.description: Manage, version and deploy prompts from within Langfuse.

routes.title: Trace Tagging - Langfuse
routes.description: Categorize and manage your traces with tags in Langfuse.

routes.title: Custom model prices (Langfuse v2.0) - Langfuse
routes.description: The new major version allows you to track usage and costs for many more models and for the first time also allows you to add custom models and prices.

routes.title: SDK-level prompt caching - Langfuse
routes.description: The latest release of the Python and JS/TS Langfuse SDK includes a new prompt caching feature that improves the reliability and performance of your applications.

routes.title: New API: GET /metrics/daily - Langfuse
routes.description: Retrieve aggregated daily usage metrics via a unified endpoint. Filters for application type, user, or tags are available for tailored data retrieval.

routes.title: Store additional structured data in Langfuse Prompt Management - Langfuse
routes.description: Version control model names, model parameters, and additional json data in Langfuse Prompt Management.

routes.title: Token/cost tracking for Claude 3 models - Langfuse
routes.description: Langfuse automatically tracks token counts and USD spend for Anthropic Claude 3 models

routes.title: Decorator-based tracing for Python - Langfuse
routes.description: Use @observe() decorator to trace Python functions, fully compatible with the native integrations with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and the OpenAI SDK.

routes.title: OpenAI Integration tracks used Langfuse Prompts - Langfuse
routes.description: The OpenAI SDK integration for Langfuse Tracing now supports capturing the used prompt (version) from Prompt Management.

routes.title: ChatML in Prompt Management - Langfuse
routes.description: Introducing the "chat" prompt type in Langfuse Prompt Management to version control and release ChatML (role/message) prompts.

routes.title: LLM playground - Langfuse
routes.description: Test and iterate on your prompts with the new LLM playground directly in Langfuse.

routes.title: Decorator-based integration for Python - Langfuse
routes.description: The decorator now supports all Langfuse features and is the recommended way to use Langfuse in Python.

routes.title: Datasets v2 - Langfuse
routes.description: New editor, metadata on all objects, tables that render i/o, dataset runs on traces, push traces to datasets, and more.

routes.title: Model-based evaluations - Langfuse
routes.description: Run model-based evaluations on traces in Langfuse to scale your evaluation workflows. Start with one of our battletested templates or use your own custom templates.

routes.title: Prompt management REST API and deployment labels - Langfuse
routes.description: Manage prompts via the REST API and add labels to deploy prompts to different environments.

routes.title: Playground and evaluations with GPT-4o - Langfuse
routes.description: Experiment with OpenAI GPT-4o in the playground and use it to power evaluations

routes.title: Token/cost tracking for GPT-4o models - Langfuse
routes.description: Day 1 support for OpenAI GPT-4o including tracking token counts and USD spend.

routes.title: Annotation Drawer - Langfuse
routes.description: Annotate traces and LLM responses via the new annotation drawer. You can define a standardized set of scores and criteria for your project.

routes.title: New Docs and Cookbook: Monitoring LLM Security - Langfuse
routes.description: LLM security requires effective run-time checks and ex-post monitoring and evaluation. We have added new documentation and a cookbook on how to effectively leverage popular LLM security tools while evaluating them in Langfuse.

routes.title: Datasets API v2 - Langfuse
routes.description: Introduction of the new Datasets API v2 with improved performance for large datasets. Also, now all datasets-related objects are directly accessible via the API.

routes.title: Query Traces via SDKs - Langfuse
routes.description: The Langfuse Python and JS SDKs now support fetching traces and observations from the Langfuse API. Use them for custom analysis, few-shotting or fine-tuning workflows.

routes.title: Create Non-Numeric Scores via SDKs - Langfuse
routes.description: The Langfuse API, Python and JS SDKs now support creating categorical, boolean and numeric scores.

routes.title: Token/cost tracking for GPT-4o mini - Langfuse
routes.description: Day 1 support for OpenAI GPT-4o mini including tracking token counts and USD spend.

routes.title: Organizations - Langfuse
routes.description: Introducing organizations to manage projects and permissions across larger teams working in Langfuse.

routes.title: UI Customization - Langfuse
routes.description: You can now replace the documentation, support and feedback links in the UI with references to your internal resources. This helps roll out Langfuse in your organization and ensures that users can find the information they need.

routes.title: Advanced Score Analytics Charts - Langfuse
routes.description: Explore customizable charts for aggregate and time series analytics, grouped by score type, source and name.

routes.title: Comments on Langfuse objects - Langfuse
routes.description: Add comments to traces, observations, sessions and prompts via the Langfuse UI.

routes.title: Support for Multi-Modal Traces in Langfuse UI - Langfuse
routes.description: Add multiple modalities to a single trace, including text and images.

routes.title: Headless Initialization of Self-Hosted Deployments - Langfuse
routes.description: Automatically initialize Langfuse resources on startup using environment variables, streamlining self-hosted deployments and infrastructure-as-code integrations.

routes.title: Enhanced Zero-Latency Prompt Management - Langfuse
routes.description: Langfuse prompt management now guarantees instant access to prompts after first use while refreshing the cached version in the background.

routes.title: Custom Base Path for Self-Hosted Deployments - Langfuse
routes.description: Deploy Langfuse behind a custom base path for more flexible self-hosting configurations.

routes.title: Token/cost tracking for OpenAI's o1 models - Langfuse
routes.description: Day 1 support for OpenAI's o1 models including tracking token counts and USD spend.

routes.title: Link prompts to Langchain executions - Langfuse
routes.description: Prompt management just got more powerful for Langchain users by linking Langfuse prompts to Langchain executions.

routes.title: Annotation Queues - Langfuse
routes.description: Manage your annotation tasks with ease using our new workflow tooling. Create queues, add traces to them, and get a simple UI to review and label LLM application traces in Langfuse.

routes.title: Langfuse LLM-as-a-judge now supports any (tool-calling) LLM - Langfuse
routes.description: Tool calling makes Langfuse Evals reliable. Previously, only OpenAI models were supported. With this update, you can use any tool-calling LLM when setting up an LLM-as-a-judge evaluator.

routes.title: Event input and output masking - Langfuse
routes.description: Configure SDK-side masking to redact sensitive information from inputs and outputs sent to the Langfuse server.

routes.title: Dataset Run Comparison View - Langfuse
routes.description: After running experiments on datasets, you can now compare results side-by-side, view metrics, and peek into details of each dataset item across runs.

routes.title: LLM-as-a-judge Evaluators for Dataset Experiments - Langfuse
routes.description: Introducing support for managed LLM-as-a-judge evaluators for dataset experiments.

routes.title: Full multi-modal support, including audio, images, and attachments - Langfuse
routes.description: Add multi-modal attachments to LLM traces in Langfuse to observe, and view them within the Langfuse UI.

routes.title: All new Datasets, Experimentation and Evaluation documentation - Langfuse
routes.description: We've completely rebuilt the documentation for Datasets and Evals to make it easier to get started with offline evaluation. To celebrate Launch Week, we've also summarized all the documentation improvements we've made over the past year.

routes.title: Prompt Experiments on Datasets with LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluations - Langfuse
routes.description: Move fast on prompts without breaking things! Run experiments on Datasets and directly compare evaluation results side-by-side. Experimentation speeds up the feedback loop when working on prompts and prevents regressions when making rapid changes.

routes.title: SSO with GitHub Enterprise and Keycloak - Langfuse
routes.description: Langfuse now supports GitHub Enterprise and Keycloak as SSO providers on Langfuse Cloud and self-hosted instances

routes.title: Improved cost tracking - Langfuse
routes.description: Langfuse now supports cost tracking all usage types such as cached tokens, audio tokens, reasoning tokens, etc.

routes.title: Audit Logs - Langfuse
routes.description: As part of our ongoing effort to improve Langfuse for larger teams, we are excited to announce that audit logs are now available on Enterprise/Teams plans.

routes.title: Track changes between prompt versions - Langfuse
routes.description: See a detailed comparison of changes between prompt versions. Optionally, you can also review changes before creating a new prompt version.

routes.title: Configure additional HTTP headers for LLM API keys - Langfuse
routes.description: Configure additional HTTP headers for LLM API keys to include custom headers in requests to provider endpoints, particularly useful for OpenAI-compliant LLM proxies.

routes.title: Dataset CSV upload - Langfuse
routes.description: Create your Datasets in seconds

routes.title: Commit Messages on Prompt Versions - Langfuse
routes.description: Document your updates to prompts

routes.title: Project-level Data Retention Policies - Langfuse
routes.description: Automatically remove event data outside of a specified retention period.

routes.title: New API Reference - Langfuse
routes.description: Langfuse now has a new API Reference with interactive examples.

routes.title: New Prompt Editor - Langfuse
routes.description: Complex prompts are easier to edit with our new prompt editor, which supports variable highlighting.

routes.title: JS/TS SDK supports trace sampling - Langfuse
routes.description: Trace sampling is now supported in the JS SDK and integrations.

routes.title: OpenAI o3-mini support for playground and cost tracking - Langfuse
routes.description: Two hours ago, OpenAI released the latest version of their o3-mini model. Langfuse now supports this model in both the LLM playground and cost tracking.

routes.title: Typed public API client in SDKs - Langfuse
routes.description: Access all of Langfuse public API resources via a typed client in our SDKs

routes.title: Gemini 2.0 support for playground and cost tracking - Langfuse
routes.description: Langfuse says hello to Gemini 2.0 Flash, Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite, and Gemini 2.0 Pro. Support added for both the LLM playground and cost tracking.

routes.title: Use JsonPath to select from Input, Output, or Metadata values in LLM as a Judge - Langfuse
routes.description: Use JsonPath to select from Input, Output, or Metadata in LLM as a Judge for more precise evaluation prompts.

routes.title: Trace UI filtered view by log-level - Langfuse
routes.description: Focus on the most relevant elements of your trace by using log-level filters

routes.title: OpenTelemetry Tracing Support - Langfuse
routes.description: Push your OpenTelemetry Spans to Langfuse

routes.title: Graph view for LangGraph traces - Langfuse
routes.description: Follow your LangGraph agent execution on a graph view

routes.title: Model Context Protocol Prompt Server - Langfuse
routes.description: Use Langfuse prompts in your LLM Agent systems, Claude Desktop, and Cursor and other MCP Clients via the new MCP Server.

routes.title: Execute LLM-as-a-judge evaluations on existing data - Langfuse
routes.description: You can now choose to execute LLM-as-a-judge evaluations on existing, new, or all data.

routes.title: Google AI Studio support - Langfuse
routes.description: Langfuse now supports access to Gemini models via Google AI Studio.

routes.title: OpenAI GPT-4.5 support - Langfuse
routes.description: Langfuse now offers full support for OpenAI's GPT-4.5, featuring day-one integration with our LLM playground, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation system, and comprehensive cost tracking capabilities.

routes.title: Add support for WorkOS Identity Provider - Langfuse
routes.description: When self-hosting or on Langfuse Cloud Teams Plan, you can now use WorkOS as an Identity Provider (IdP).

routes.title: Add support for Native Environments - Langfuse
routes.description: Use native environment to separate staging, dev, and production systems within the same Langfuse project.

routes.title: Prompt Composability - Langfuse
routes.description: Create modular, reusable prompts by referencing existing prompts within other prompts.

routes.title: Batch-export Scores via UI - Langfuse
routes.description: Evaluation scores can now be exported in bulk directly from the Langfuse UI for easier analysis and reporting. Supports CSV and JSON formats.

routes.title: New Prompt View - Langfuse
routes.description: Our redesigned prompt view brings enhanced visualization, version comparison, and search capabilities.

routes.title: New Trace View - Langfuse
routes.description: Introducing our redesigned trace view with improved hierarchy visualization, timeline/tree toggle, and powerful search capabilities.

routes.title: Tool Calling and Structured Output in Playground - Langfuse
routes.description: Define and test tool calls and structured output schemas directly in the Langfuse Playground

routes.title: Protected prompt labels - Langfuse
routes.description: Langfuse now supports protected prompt labels for better access control over your prompt deployment workflow

routes.title: Admin APIs for Organization and Project Management - Langfuse
routes.description: Langfuse now supports administrative actions via APIs across organizations and projects.

routes.title: Session Level Scores - Langfuse
routes.description: Create and manage scores at the session level for more comprehensive evaluation of conversational AI applications

routes.title: Dataset Run Level Scores - Langfuse
routes.description: Score dataset runs to assess the overall quality of each run

routes.title: Metrics API for custom analytics - Langfuse
routes.description: Build custom reports and dashboards with our flexible Metrics API. Query traces, observations, and scores with custom dimensions, metrics, and time granularity.

routes.title: Custom Dashboards - Langfuse
routes.description: Create your own custom dashboards or use Langfuse-curated dashboards to analyze and understand your AI application deeply.

routes.title: OTEL-based Python SDK - Langfuse
routes.description: The latest generation of the Langfuse Python SDK, built on the OpenTelemetry framework.

routes.title: Langfuse Evaluator Library - Langfuse
routes.description: Introducing the Langfuse Evaluator Library with prebuilt evaluators. Plus, enjoy a revamped UX with trace and variable previews for easier LLM evaluation.

routes.title: Python SDK v3 is now Generally Available - Langfuse
routes.description: The OpenTelemetry-based Python SDK v3 is now stable and ready for production use.

routes.title: Organize Your Prompts in Folders - Langfuse
routes.description: Use slashes in prompt names to create folders for better organization.

routes.title: Histogram Charts in Custom Dashboards - Langfuse
routes.description: Visualize data distributions with the new histogram chart type in Langfuse custom dashboards.

routes.title: Pivot Tables in Custom Dashboards - Langfuse
routes.description: Analyze multi-dimensional data with the new pivot table widget in Langfuse custom dashboards.

routes.title: Search to Navigate Large Prompt Collections - Langfuse
routes.description: Now it is easier to find prompts in prompt management via the new search bar

routes.title: Message Placeholders in Chat Prompts - Langfuse
routes.description: Inject context or message history into your chat prompts at just the right spot.

routes.title: n8n Node for Langfuse Prompt Management - Langfuse
routes.description: Use Langfuse's prompt management capabilities directly in your n8n workflows to build powerful no-code agents.

routes.title: Webhooks for Prompt Changes - Langfuse
routes.description: Get real-time notifications for new prompt versions, changes to deployment labels or tags, and other edits.

routes.title: Trigger Remote Custom Evaluations from the Langfuse UI - Langfuse
routes.description: Enable non-technical users to trigger external experiment pipelines directly from the Langfuse UI on datasets.

routes.title: LLM Playground with Side-by-Side Comparison - Langfuse
routes.description: The LLM Playground now supports side-by-side prompt comparison with parallel LLM execution.

routes.title: Sessions in Annotation Queues - Langfuse
routes.description: Annotation Queues now support session-level annotation, making it easier to evaluate multi-turn interactions in your LLM applications.

routes.title: Slack Integration for Prompt Webhooks - Langfuse
routes.description: Receive prompt change notifications directly in your Slack channels with our native integration.

routes.title: Additional provider options in LLM calls in playground and evals - Langfuse
routes.description: Set additional provider options in your LLM calls in playground and in llm-as-a-judge evaluations.

routes.title: Additional Observation Types for More Meaningful Span Context - Langfuse
routes.description: New observation types including Agent, Tool, Chain, Retriever, Evaluator, Embedding, and Guardrail provide semantic meaning to your traces.

routes.title: TypeScript SDK v4 (GA) - Langfuse
routes.description: The new OpenTelemetry-based TypeScript SDK v4 is now generally available with improved DX, modular packages, and seamless integrations.

routes.title: Experiment Runner SDK - Langfuse
routes.description: New high-level SDK abstraction for running experiments on datasets with automatic tracing, concurrent execution, and flexible evaluation.

routes.title: Mutable Score Configs - Langfuse
routes.description: Score configurations can now be updated after creation. Modify existing configs via API/SDK and UI while keeping all your data safe.

routes.title: Structured Output Support for Prompt Experiments - Langfuse
routes.description: Enforce JSON schema response formats in prompt experiments to ensure consistent, parseable outputs for evaluation and analysis.

routes.title: Spend Alerts - Langfuse
routes.description: Monitor your organization's cloud spending and receive notifications when costs exceed predefined monetary thresholds.

routes.title: LLM-as-a-Judge Execution Tracing & Enhanced Observability - Langfuse
routes.description: Every LLM-as-a-Judge evaluator execution now creates a trace, allowing you to inspect the exact prompts, responses, and token usage for each evaluation.

routes.title: @Mentions and Reactions in Comments - Langfuse
routes.description: Tag teammates with @mentions to notify them instantly, and add emoji reactions to comments for quick acknowledgments.

routes.title: JSON Schema Enforcement for Dataset Items - Langfuse
routes.description: Define JSON schemas for your dataset inputs and expected outputs to ensure data quality and consistency across your test datasets.

routes.title: Filters in Compare View - Langfuse
routes.description: Filter experiment results in the compare view to focus on specific subsets, such as items where evaluator scores dropped below a threshold

routes.title: Score Analytics with Multi-Score Comparison - Langfuse
routes.description: Validate evaluation reliability and uncover insights with comprehensive score analysis. Compare different evaluation methods, track trends over time, and measure agreement between human annotators and LLM judges.

routes.title: Hosted MCP Server for Langfuse Prompt Management - Langfuse
routes.description: Langfuse now includes a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with write capabilities, enabling AI agents to fetch and update prompts directly.

routes.title: Pricing Tiers for Accurate Model Cost Tracking - Langfuse
routes.description: Langfuse now supports pricing tiers for models with context-dependent pricing, enabling accurate cost calculation for models with context-dependent pricing.

routes.title: Dataset Item Versioning - Langfuse
routes.description: Track dataset changes over time with automatic versioning on every addition, update, or deletion of dataset items.

routes.title: v2 Metrics and Observations API (Beta) - Langfuse
routes.description: New high-performance v2 APIs for metrics and observations with cursor-based pagination, selective field retrieval, and optimized data architecture.

routes.title: Inline Comments on Observation I/O - Langfuse
routes.description: Anchor comments to specific text selections within trace and observation input, output, and metadata fields.

routes.title: Corrected Outputs for Traces and Observations - Langfuse
routes.description: Capture improved versions of LLM outputs directly in trace views. Build fine-tuning datasets and drive continuous improvement with domain expert feedback.

routes.description: Fetch datasets at specific version timestamps and run experiments on historical dataset versions via UI, API, and SDKs for full reproducibility.

routes.description: Fully use Langfuse from the CLI. Built for AI agents and power users.
